text:
Maria (runtime): Quick check — after the allocator bump in PR #789 I'm seeing ~+12% RSS on canaries vs prod on the smallalloc-heavy bench. Can someone run a memmap diff + per-arena fragmentation breakdown? I attached the pmap and a short jemalloc dump.

Devin: Which bench exactly? smallalloc-runner v2 with seq_len=1024? If so I can spin one up. Also try to grab `/proc/$PID/smaps` and jemalloc stats.

Sam R: I can take this in ~1h. ping me when you have the PID. Curious if THP or madvise flags changed in the new image. :mag:

Leo: did a quick compare earlier — canary shows more non-contiguous mmaps and higher "wasted" bytes in arenas. Summary I saw: unused_arena +18MB, committed_pages +6%. Could be arena split policy.

Devin: quick repro commands to run (copy/paste):
```
sudo perf record -p $PID -g -- sleep 30
cat /proc/$PID/smaps | egrep 'Anon|Private|Swap|Rss'
jeprof --text /path/to/libjemalloc.so $PID > /tmp/jeprof.txt
python3 tools/jemalloc_stats.py --pid $PID --out /tmp/jstats.json
```

Maria (runtime): thanks. Sam — when you run can you also capture per-arena stats (free pages / total pages) and MALLOC_CONF in effect? Example: `mallctl -n stats.arenas` and `mallctl -n opt.background_thread` if available.

alloc-bot: snapshot created at s3://redwood-snapshots/mem-diffs/1938765432.tar.gz (automated) :floppy_disk:

Sam R: ran the bench and uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-snapshots/mem-diffs/1938765432/bench-logs.tar.gz. Quick grep:
```
arena0_free: 2.1M
arena1_free: 14.8M
total_mapped: 742M
fragmentation_ratio: 1.12
```

Devin: thanks. Those per-arena imbalances point to a change in arena assignment or decay behavior. Do we have a config diff between canary and prod images (glibc/jemalloc versions)?

Leo: checked image layers — jemalloc bumped from 5.2.1 -> 5.3.0 in the canary build, plus MALLOC_CONF default tweaks in the distro patch. I'm opening a minimal repro and a bisect job now.

Maria (runtime): good catch. Two ask items: 1) try running canary with old jemalloc (static linked) to confirm, 2) if repro holds, hold the canary rollout and open a rollback PR.

Sam R: did a quick swap — rebuilt canary with jemalloc 5.2.1 and ran the same bench. Delta drops to ~+0.6% RSS. Repro looks like it tracks the jemalloc bump.

Devin: actionable tuning we can try in the short term: MALLOC_CONF=\"background_thread:true, decay_time:10, aggressive_decay:true\" or set `oversize_threshold` lower. Not a long-term fix but helpful to validate.

Maria (runtime): sounds like next steps: Leo opens the bisect + bug with repro, Sam + Devin iterate on MALLOC_CONF experiment, and we pause canary rollout until we confirm. I'll mark the rollout hold. :thumbsup:

Leo: created bug: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RINF-4567 with repro instructions and artifacts. Also added a bisect pipeline link.

Sam R: ran MALLOC_CONF experiment — `background_thread:true, decay_time:5` reduced wasted arena bytes by ~10% and brought RSS down ~5% vs canary baseline. Pushed results to the bug.

alloc-bot: incident MEM-1938765432 created, severity: low, owner: eng-runtime (auto).

Devin: I'll add a lightweight metric to the canary job to surface per-arena fragmentation so we catch this earlier.

Maria (runtime): thanks team. If the bisect points to a jemalloc behavioral change we should notify infra & consider pinning the version for next release. Reopen thread if you need a quick sync. :eyes:
